name: 国立新美術館
hoursEn: 10 am to 6 pm, closed Tuesdays (check the exhibition)

door.t: 国立新美術館 正面入口
door.en: The National Art Center, Tokyo, main entrance
door.n: 美術館 (びじゅつかん) is an art museum: 美術 (art) + 館 (building, hall). 正面入口 (しょうめんいりぐち) is the main entrance. 新 (しん) means new.

enter: Walk in through the glass entrance.

ticket.n: 売り場 (うりば) is where something is sold. 大人一枚ください (おとないちまいください): one adult ticket, please. The atrium itself is free (入場無料, にゅうじょうむりょう).

info.n: Ask here: 展覧会はどこですか？ (てんらんかいはどこですか): where is the exhibition? 展覧会 is an exhibition.

gallery.n: 展示室 (てんじしつ) are the exhibition rooms. This museum has no collection of its own: it hosts big exhibitions, so check what's on (開催中, かいさいちゅう).

lockers.n: The lockers take a ¥100 coin that you get back (返却式, へんきゃくしき). 荷物 (にもつ) is luggage.

photo.n: 撮影 (さつえい) is taking photos or filming, 禁止 (きんし) means forbidden. In the atrium photos are fine; in many exhibitions they're not.

cafe.n: The ground-floor café, beside the glass wall. コーヒーを一つお願いします (ひとつおねがいします): one coffee, please.

brasserie.t: ブラッスリー ポール・ボキューズ ミュゼ
brasserie.en: Brasserie Paul Bocuse Le Musée (3F, on the big cone)
brasserie.n: The French restaurant sits on top of the big inverted cone, 3階 (さんがい), third floor. 予約 (よやく) is a reservation.

salon.t: サロン・ド・テ ロンド
salon.en: Salon de Thé Rond (2F, on the small cone)
salon.n: A tea room on top of the smaller cone, 2階 (にかい). 円錐 (えんすい) means cone.

exit.n: 出口 (でぐち) is exit and 入口 (いりぐち) is entrance.

escalator.n: The upper floors and galleries aren't in the game yet.
